headline_marked: Bangladesh Air Force [[recruiting Officer Cadets]] for 95th BAF Academy Course; apply by Sep 5, 2026
headline: Bangladesh Air Force recruiting Officer Cadets for 95th BAF Academy Course; apply by Sep 5, 2026
summary: The Bangladesh Air Force has issued a recruitment circular for Officer Cadets in four categories under the 95th BAF Academy Course. Interested candidates can apply until September 5, 2026.
details: The Bangladesh Air Force has announced a recruitment drive for Officer Cadets under the 95th BAF Academy Course. Applications are open for four categories, with the deadline set for September 5, 2026. This offers a significant opportunity for young individuals to join the nation's air defense.

Eligibility criteria include specific academic qualifications for each category. For GD (P), Engineering, Logistics/ATC/ADWC/Meteorology, candidates need a minimum GPA of 4.50 in science in both SSC and HSC/equivalent exams, with specific letter grades in Physics, Math, and Chemistry as applicable.

Admin category applicants require a minimum GPA of 4.50 in any discipline in both SSC and HSC/equivalent exams. All candidates must be unmarried and meet specific height requirements: at least 63 inches for female GD (P) candidates and 62 inches for other female branches.

Disqualifications include being dismissed or voluntarily retired from any armed force or government job, or being screened out twice by ISSB. Candidates who had LASIK surgery before age 18 are ineligible. If LASIK was performed after 18, a minimum waiting period of 1 year for GD (P) and 6 months for other branches is required before medical examination.

During the training period, Officer Cadets will receive a monthly salary of BDT 10,000. Upon successful completion of the 3-year training at Bangladesh Air Force Academy, including 10 weeks at Bangladesh Military Academy, they will be commissioned as 'Flying Officers'.

Commissioned officers will also receive a 4-year Bachelor (Honors) degree, which includes the first year post-commissioning. Further details and the application process are available on the official website by clicking 'Apply Now'.
